name: Variant Selector
summary: Product-option composition whose fieldset-and-legend groups use named native radios, keep sold-out values inspectable, disable nonexistent combinations, and delegate coordinated product projection to one commerce target.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Collection containing one or more product-option groups.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.description: Native fieldset for one product option and its same-name radio values.

anatomy.name: legend
anatomy.description: First legend that supplies the stable visible and accessible group label.

anatomy.name: groupLabel
anatomy.description: Stable localized product-option name inside the legend.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with each required product-option group label.

anatomy.name: selectedValue
anatomy.description: Derived visible selected value; it is not an independent value owner and may be hidden from the accessible legend name.

anatomy.name: swatches
anatomy.description: Wrapping visual-swatch presentation for one native radio group.

anatomy.name: swatch
anatomy.description: Wrapping label and 44px target for one visual option.

anatomy.name: swatchInput
anatomy.description: Named native radio that owns the swatch option value and state.

anatomy.name: swatchColor
anatomy.description: Target-provided color or image surface; never the option's only name.

anatomy.name: swatchLabel
anatomy.description: Localized accessible name for the visual option.

anatomy.name: pills
anatomy.description: Wrapping text-pill presentation for one native radio group.

anatomy.name: pill
anatomy.description: Wrapping label and minimum 44px target for one textual option.

anatomy.name: pillInput
anatomy.description: Named native radio that owns the pill option value and state.

anatomy.name: pillLabel
anatomy.description: Visible localized text naming the pill option.

anatomy.name: optionStatus
anatomy.description: Localized accessible commercial status such as unavailable; targets omit it when not applicable.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Product option groups always begin with a selected value; unavailable combinations are commerce state rather than generic validation variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One product-option density with minimum 44px targets.

states.name: default
states.description: One or more available native option groups.

states.name: hover
states.description: Hover-capable pointer feedback on interactive options.

states.name: checkedSwatch
states.description: Selected swatch boundary derived from native checkedness.

states.name: focusSwatch
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator distinct from selected swatch state.

states.name: checkedPill
states.description: Selected pill surface derived from native checkedness.

states.name: focusPill
states.description: Keyboard focus indicator distinct from selected pill state.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: Commercially unavailable value with localized text and a non-color cue; it is not automatically native-disabled.

states.name: disabledOption
states.description: Native-disabled nonexistent combination or genuinely unusable option.

behavior.name: nativeGroup
behavior.description: Each group uses one fieldset/legend and same-name native radios. HTML owns mutual exclusion, one group value, keyboard operation, events, validity, FormData, and reset without a redundant radiogroup role or neutral JavaScript.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
attributes: checked establishes initial checkedness in static HTML
one controlled or uncontrolled value per group in framework adapters
behavior.description: Static Web delegates live state to native radios. Controlled targets bind one value per option group rather than unrelated option booleans.

behavior.name: derivedSelection
behavior.description: Visible selected-value text is derived from the checked radio and is never a second editable value owner. Targets keep it synchronized when the native selection changes.

behavior.name: availability
behavior.description: Under D4-A, sold-out values remain selectable with localized status and a non-color cue; nonexistent combinations and genuinely unusable values use native disabled. Selection never makes unavailable merchandise purchasable.

behavior.name: swatchData
behavior.description: Color or image surfaces are authored target data. Every swatch retains a localized option name independent from its visual surface.

behavior.name: variantCoordination
behavior.description: Native input/change requests selection. The parent product page, quick view, or commerce adapter resolves the complete combination and coordinates variant id, availability, URL, Price, media, inventory, selling plan, submit state, and at most one localized status. Neutral Variant Selector does not duplicate this service.

behavior.name: intrinsicLayout
behavior.description: Groups and options wrap from available inline size without viewport-specific DOM, source-order, or keyboard-order changes.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Stable visible label for one repeated product-option group.

properties.name: optionLabel
properties.description: Localized name for one repeated option value, visible on pills and accessible for swatches.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native radio name shared by every value in one option group.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Stable target value for one repeated option radio.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Establishes initial checkedness in static HTML; controlled adapters bind one live group value.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires one checked value in each rendered native option group and shows the standardized decorative marker once on that group's stable label.

properties.name: groupDisabled
properties.description: Disables every option in a repeated group through its native fieldset.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Native-disabled state for a nonexistent combination or genuinely unusable repeated option, independent from inspectable sold-out state.

properties.name: unavailable
properties.description: Marks one repeated option sold out while keeping it selectable for inspection under accepted D4-A policy.

properties.name: unavailableText
properties.description: Localized accessible status appended to an unavailable option; required by the target whenever unavailable is true.

accessibility: Render every option group as a native fieldset with a first legend and same-name native radio inputs. Do not add redundant radiogroup/radio roles or recreate arrow-key focus behavior.
Keep one stable localized accessible group label. If the visual legend includes a derived selected value, hide only that redundant fragment from the accessible name.
Give every radio a non-empty localized option label independent from color, image, selected state, tooltip, or commercial status.
Keep native checked, required, group disabled, option disabled, input/change, FormData, reset, and constraint-validation behavior. A target that controls state binds one value per group.

Keep sold-out commercial unavailability distinct from native disabled interaction. Sold-out values remain selectable with localized associated text and a non-color cue; nonexistent combinations and genuinely unusable values are disabled.
Provide at least a 44 by 44 CSS pixel target. Preserve distinct visible selected and focus states in light, dark, forced colors, reduced motion, RTL, zoom, and narrow containers.
Do not create a live region per group. The parent commerce coordinator owns any one localized announcement after meaningful Price, media, availability, or purchase-state changes.

web.notes: Native fieldset/legend/radio composition and swatch/pill presentation are implemented in canonical Product CSS; product-data and cross-group variant resolution remain consumer-owned.

shopify.notes: Liquid distinguishes exact sold-out variants from nonexistent combinations, preserves native swatches and granular option ids, and one target coordinator performs high-variant Section Rendering, Combined Listing product_url navigation, bounded dependent updates, focus restoration, URL synchronization and one status.

react.notes: The shared Exhibit/Studio renderer proves group-level controlled values, native change semantics, selectable sold-out values and disabled invalid combinations. Consumers may expose one controlled value or uncontrolled default value per group.
